title: Cherry Grove Cherries
description: This mod add cherries that you can find within the leaves of Cherry Blossoms! If you find food difficult to find in Cherry Groves, this is the mod for you!
body:
This mod add some new culinary delights to your Minecraft World: Cherries!

Cherries are quite the simple food, providing similar stats to apples. They are obtained from Cherry Blossom leaves to add more food sources to the Cherry grove.

You can also make Golden Cherries, which unlike the Golden Apple, provide a small strength boost, along with doubling your health for a minute!

The general purpose of this mod is to add a food to the Cherry Grove that is as Vanilla as possible. It's not perfect at all, but I think it can make a nice addition to your modpacks! Enjoy!! :D
